name: 行政通知の公示方法を変更
summary: 現在は、通知事項などを書いた書面を区役所の門前掲示場に掲示する方法が定められています。この議案では、公示事項を不特定多数の人が閲覧できる状態にし、区の事務所で掲示するか、設置した機器の画面で見られるようにします。公示の措置を始めてから2週間が過ぎると、通知が相手に届いたものとみなします。
changes: 公示による通知の方法を、総務省令で定める方法での公開と事務所での掲示または電子表示に改める
公示の措置を始めてから2週間が過ぎたときに、通知が到達したものとみなす
who: 不利益処分の名宛人となる人
why: 行政手続法の改正を踏まえ、公示送達の方法を改めるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes how administrative notices are made public
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Katsushika City Administrative Procedures Ordinance
en.summary: Currently, the rules require written notices and other information to be posted on the notice board in front of the ward office gate. Under this bill, matters to be made public will be made available for the general public to view, by posting them at a ward office or displaying them on the screen of installed equipment. A notice will be deemed to have reached its recipient two weeks after the public-notice measures begin.
changes: Changes the method of notification by public notice to publication in a manner prescribed by a Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications ordinance, and posting at an office or displaying the information electronically
Deems a notice to have reached its recipient when two weeks have passed since the public-notice measures began
who: People named as recipients of adverse dispositions
en.why: The ward says this is to change the method of service by public notice in light of amendments to the Administrative Procedure Act.
